svg.title: SPX daily Kalman-Keltner chart study
svg.desc: Candlestick chart of SPX daily bars with the Kalman-Keltner study: a fast centerline coloured blue while rising and yellow while falling, a slower drift line (the weekly Kalman estimate) in light blue and gold, inner Keltner bands green in bullish drift and red in bearish, and neutral outer bands. Markers show bars where the zone score fired. Generated by the production Python engine with illustrative parameters.
svg.text: Jul 29 - zone hit; +5.6% in 5 sessions, +6.6% by Aug 13
